if_impossible_or_inconsistent: STOP FOR HUMAN REVIEW; do not tune

all_five_required: documented repeated-channel or repeated-measurement series, not distinct actuators or distinct physical quantities

B_pairwise_statistic.computed_on: common finite CALIBRATION samples of development discharge s and block b in {A,B,C}

aggregates.n_valid_cells: count of cells where both signals are non-constant and finite

B_pairwise_statistic.constant_signal_in_cell: cell does not support a redundancy claim; NOT imputed

C_thresholds_STABLY_NEAR_REDUNDANT.absolute_correlation_rationale: two measurements related by a stable sign flip and affine scaling are representationally redundant for the downstream affine relation family
C_thresholds_STABLY_NEAR_REDUNDANT.sign_consistency_rationale: a pair whose relation changes sign among discharges is not one stable observational direction

D_representative_selection.graph: undirected; node = primitive; edge iff STABLY_NEAR_REDUNDANT
algorithm: among remaining nodes choose the one with the most redundancy edges to other remaining nodes
tie-break by LOWER frozen FINAL_SIGNAL_INVENTORY index
mark every remaining node DIRECTLY connected to it as REDUNDANCY_DEFERRED to that representative
remove the representative and its directly covered neighbours

C6.name: level_rate_interaction
C6.semantics: the level of one observed quantity weighted by the instantaneous rate of another
C6.note: NOT collapsed with LEVEL_RATE(j|i): the semantic roles differ and the quantities are not generally equal

C7.name: rate_over_level
C7.semantics: rate of one observed quantity relative to the level scale of another
C7.special_case_i_eq_j: fractional temporal rate; a logarithmic rate where defined; unit s^-1

C8.name: level_over_rate
C8.semantics: an observed level relative to another quantity's rate

E_constructor_catalogue.C6_C8_are_not_depth_2: C6-C8 are PRIMITIVE-PAIR constructors with an internal declared rate operator. They do NOT consume C1 coordinate objects recursively.

partial_map_predicates_symbolic_only.C6: NONE - no denominator, no singularity predicate

operand_eligibility.C6: level P_typed x rate P_dot, i may equal j
operand_eligibility.C7: rate P_dot x level P_typed, i may equal j
operand_eligibility.C8: level P_typed x rate P_dot, i may equal j

F_typing_and_domains.upstream_upsampled: level use allowed (including as the LEVEL operand of C6/C7/C8); any constructor requiring THAT signal's derivative is NUMERICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY
F_typing_and_domains.aliasing_risk: propagates from any operand; no high-frequency claim on a flagged coordinate

H_hardened_raw_ablation.definition: Ridge regression using ONLY the primitive levels in P_hard; no constructed coordinates; same calibration geometry, preprocessing and penalty-selection rule as B2; development-only tuning; frozen before external evaluation

purpose.B2_vs_H0: isolates the effect of primitive-space hardening
purpose.H0_vs_relational_SIR: isolates the effect of relational coordinate construction on the SAME hardened primitive information

forbidden_selection_criteria: feature importance from a target model
effective_rank_audit: PERMITTED AS AUDIT SUMMARY ONLY; may not determine P_hard
